subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The king followed the advice of the physician. (b) He advised the king to more heavy club in the air till he got tired. (c) He did not undergo physical labour. (d) The doctor was very wise. (e) He became bulky and could not do anything. (f) Once there was an idle king. (g) He did not prescribe any medicine. (h) He called in a doctor. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (f) + (c) + (e) + (h) + (d) + (g) + (b) + (a) Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
